scope: Native batch-size tuning, explicitly separate from source-code improvement and all-scenario requirements
validation: Duplicate-key target preserves repeats; row count, exact distinct-key count, key range and all six fields checked every run
performance_gate: Every paired round >=25% and separately >=50%; all correctness checks pass; no deleted slow rounds
configuration: One channel, 1GiB JVM, queue=1, 500000 rows, strict_mode true, max_filter_ratio zero, logged PostgreSQL source unchanged; only explicit batch byte thresholds differ in primary groups
storage: At most one disposable OLAP container at a time; new container per group, 4GiB RAM/4CPU, Doris BE60%; 6GiB between-round budget with 1GiB reserve; no new million-row source
isolation: No local build, profiling, compression or other DB jobs during paired runs; unrelated user containers retained
limitations: No whole-job atomicity, retry idempotence, billion-row guarantee; larger batches retain more in-flight memory and change commit boundaries; existing plugin defaults unchanged
